title: Add timer-based bullet firing in Godot w/ demo
instruction:
Create Scenes/Bullet.tscn with an Area2D root named Bullet. Add a Sprite2D using AssetBundle/Sprites/Bullet.png and a CollisionShape2D using a RectangleShape2D fitted closely to the visible bullet sprite; dimensions around 6 by 3 pixels are expected, with modest tolerance for a good visual fit. Create and attach Scripts/bullet.gd, and declare @export var bullet_speed: float = 100.0 as the script default. Set the Bullet scene's Inspector override for bullet_speed to about 300 so the saved scene value differs from the script default, then move the bullet right in _physics_process with position += Vector2(bullet_speed, 0) * delta. In _ready, await a SceneTree timer of about three seconds and queue_free the bullet so missed shots cannot accumulate indefinitely.

In Player.tscn, make Bullet.tscn available through an Inspector PackedScene reference, preload/load constant, or equivalent binding. Add an automatically starting, continuously repeating Timer child with an approximately one-second trigger interval and connect timeout to the firing logic. Return without shooting whenever velocity is not Vector2.ZERO or is_game_over is true. Otherwise instantiate Bullet.tscn, place the new bullet near the player's right-side gun muzzle using a player-relative offset or a Marker2D/spawn-point node, and add it to get_tree().current_scene. Ensure Game.tscn contains no pre-placed Bullet instance, save all files, and verify the stationary player fires repeatedly while moving or game-over states suppress firing and old bullets self-destruct.

subtasks.title: Create and save Bullet scene
subtasks.criterion: The Scene dock shows a root node named Bullet containing Sprite2D and CollisionShape2D children, and the editor tab shows Bullet.tscn is saved.

subtasks.title: Create bullet movement script
subtasks.criterion: The script editor displays bullet.gd attached to the Bullet node, showing the exported bullet_speed variable and the _physics_process function with Vector2 movement.

subtasks.title: Configure bullet speed and open Player
subtasks.criterion: The Inspector for Bullet.tscn shows the Bullet Speed export property set to 300, and Player.tscn is open in the editor.

subtasks.title: Add firing Timer to Player
subtasks.criterion: The Player scene tree shows a Timer child node, and the Timer's Signals panel shows the timeout signal connected to the _on_fire method.

subtasks.title: Implement player bullet spawning
subtasks.criterion: player.gd contains the bullet_scene export and _on_fire instantiation logic, and the Inspector shows Bullet.tscn assigned to the Bullet Scene property.

subtasks.title: Clean scene and add firing guards
subtasks.criterion: Game.tscn has no pre-placed bullet nodes, and player.gd's _on_fire begins with guard clauses checking velocity and is_game_over.

subtasks.title: Add bullet self-destruct and verify
subtasks.criterion: bullet.gd shows an awaited create_timer followed by queue_free inside _ready, and the game runs in the debug window showing bullets spawning and disappearing.
